name: agent-event
title: Agent Event
description: What came to the agent from outside, neither the reader nor the agent speaking: a line of a stream it watches (kind monitor), a background task's end (task), a wake-up it had set (wake). One light grey pill at the conversation's start edge, as wide as it needs, 28px high (36px on a phone): its kind's icon, its source (the kind's word or the app's source), what it said cut short (whole on hover), when (time). With details (a task's report) it is a button opening the report under it in a bordered box that scrolls past 24rem, meta (what it cost, e.g. "12 tool uses · 3m 20s") at its foot, else at the line's end; status failed or stopped says so after its words, an alert or a stop before them, by weight, not a colour. In an AgentTurn it is a part ({ type: "event" }) where it came, never folded into a run of steps, events in a row close together; between turns, rendered itself. foldKey keeps it opened under a FoldProvider; its words are labels (in a turn, its labels.event, a part's own labels over them).
